notes: Machine readable part of PluginYG2.md. 'simple' rules are safe to apply automatically, the rest need a human or a smarter pass.

placeholders.{saves}: static wrapper class of the game save object, for example SuikaSaves
placeholders.{module}: module the call belongs to: Data, Ads, Language, Leaderboards

rules.note: field names may be renamed at the same time
means 'saves are available' in most games; for other modules use JTLSDK.<module>.IsReady
handler signature changes from Action<string> to Action<Language>
cache LanguageCodes in a static field
onCloseRewardedAdv and onErrorRewardedAdv subscriptions are deleted, the single callback replaces them
the SDK keeps the interstitial interval itself and answers NotShown inside it
the editor only branch can be deleted, the Game view overlay switches the device
no analytics module in the SDK yet

deletes.what: define symbols of optional PluginYG2 modules
deletes.note: keep the body, drop the guard

manual: Build the save wrapper from the SavesYG partial class and route every field through it.
Add the bootstrap with JTLSDK.Create, JTLSDK.Data.Loaded and JTLSDK.GameEvents.GameReady.
Create the platform configuration in the SDK window, install the template, move languages, leaderboards, products and flags into it.
Remove plugin objects and dead service objects from the scenes.
Import old player saves from the plugin key if the game is already published.
